item.title: Jury tosses Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and its boss Sam Altman
item.description: Jurors spent nearly a month hearing and viewing evidence in the high-profile trial, where Musk had accused Altman of "stealing a charity".

item.title: Jury dismisses all claims in Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI CEO Sam Altman
item.description: Musk had sought to oust Altman from his leadership position over claims that he and others breached their duty to OpenAI's original nonprofit mission and unjustly enriched themselves.

item.title: NPR trims jobs in newsroom overhaul as it confronts era without public funding
item.description: NPR is offering buyouts to journalists as it overhauls its newsroom, with the threat of layoffs to follow. Two recent gifts totaling $113 million are primarily dedicated to NPR's tech infrastructure.

item.title: Son of radicals, Zayd Ayers Dohrn details a childhood underground and on the run
item.description: Dohrn's parents, Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn, helped found the the Weather Underground. "I knew that the FBI was chasing us," he says. His memoir is Dangerous, Dirty, Violent, and Young.

item.title: Burnham pledges not to 're-run' Brexit arguments
item.description: The potential leadership challenger says he is not proposing the UK considers rejoining the EU.

item.title: Bodies of missing Italian divers found in Maldives
item.description: The bodies of all five Italian divers who died in the Maldives last week have now been found, officials tell the BBC.

item.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
item.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.

item.title: At least 100 deaths reported in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo as six Americans exposed
item.description: One of the six Americans is experiencing symptoms, according to media reports. One province in Congo reports 390 cases.

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Judge rules gun and writings are admissible in Luigi Mangione's New York murder trial
item.description: Other items found with Mangione at a Pennsylvania McDonald's will not be allowed to be presented in court, the judge ruled.
